description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeePersonalDetailModel that models personal details of an employee in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like name, ID, nationality, and other personal attributes, and constructs filters for serialization based on configuration settings.

classes.name: EmployeePersonalDetailModel
classes.description: A model class used for serializing employee personal details, employing configuration to include or exclude fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity and sets up filters for serialization based on system configuration.
